prs.title: Server Auth: DPoP Proof Validation (SEP-1932)
prs.author: PieterKas
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs add the same set of DPoP conformance test client fixtures (auth-test-dpop-bearer.ts, auth-test-dpop-no-as-nonce.ts, and presumably the rest of the auth-test-dpop-* suite) under examples/clients/typescript/ for SEP-1932 DPoP proof validation. The file diffs are byte-identical (same blob hashes 6ddd4ea8 and 0c395c4f), meaning these test clients were authored once and submitted twice as part of two different framing PRs (client-side 'Server Auth: DPoP Proof Validation' vs 'Authorization Server: DPoP Support'). (2 PRs)

prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs introduce byte-identical copies of the same DPoP test-client fixtures (identical blob hashes for auth-test-dpop-bearer.ts and auth-test-dpop-no-as-nonce.ts), so merging both would duplicate these files/history. #395 is scoped explicitly to DPoP proof validation, which is the direct subject of these test fixtures, making it the more natural home for this shared test infrastructure; #396's authorization-server DPoP support work can rebase onto #395 once merged to avoid the duplicate file additions.
